category_title: Struggling readers who use physical activity and gestures to participate
student_description: Luis is an active, kinesthetic learner who participates in literacy activities through physical movement and gestures. He struggles with word recall and encoding, often guessing letters, and is highly sensitive to public failure. He uniquely requires auditory segmenting for spelling correction, discreet whispered prompting to save face during public reading, and opportunities to connect his out-of-school literacy practices to the classroom.

criteria.rationale: Understanding what Luis values as text outside of school helps bridge his home communication patterns with classroom literacy.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan includes structured opportunities for the student to bring in and share items or texts from home to connect with his out-of-school literacy practices.
